items.title: Intuit to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.68 billion
items.text: Intuit is offloading a segment that has slowed down revenue growth, for less than a third of what it paid to acquire Mailchimp in 2021.

items.title: MoonPay seeks US bank charter for stablecoin, custody services
items.text: MoonPay’s proposed national trust bank would offer stablecoin issuance and redemption, reserve management and digital asset custody under federal oversight.

items.title: Palo Alto stock jumps on earnings beat and company's big bet on securing open-weight models
items.text: Palo Alto Networks reported better-than-expected first-quarter results and inked a $4.5 billion deal for AI startup Applied Compute

items.title: Amazon app warns New York of higher costs if Mamdani delivery law passes
items.text: Amazon has lobbied heavily against the proposed legislation, while New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani backed the bill earlier this year.

items.title: Hyperliquid Anthropic futures priced within 1% of Nasdaq opening price
items.text: Hyperliquid traders priced Anthropic futures within 1% of the stock’s Nasdaq opening price, as trading surged ahead of the AI company’s IPO.

items.title: Kraken parent's acquisition of Tribe Capital flags new chapter in evolution of crypto exchanges
items.text: Payward, the owner of crypto exchange Kraken, is pushing into private markets with its purchase of venture capital and asset management provider Tribe Capital.

items.title: Peterson: Nvidia’s leadership crisis tests the chipmaker’s role as the ‘central bank of AI’
items.text: The tech giant's web of ties to other companies is raising the possibility that it could do far-reaching economic and financial damage.

items.title: Peterson: The Fed's chairman sees an AI revolution coming. Now he has to figure out what it means
items.text: Kevin Warsh sees AI at a turning point. He faces tough questions on jobs and interest rates.

items.title: Trump’s SEC nominee Johnson backs formal rulemaking for tokenized stock trading
items.text: Former CFTC Commissioner and Democrat Kristin Johnson and ex-SEC aide Steven Levine appeared before lawmakers Thursday.

items.title: Sky's USDS stablecoin shrinks 35% as $1.5 billion exits reserves after illicit-finance report
items.text: USDS held its $1 peg as a large holder linked to Poloniex withdrew much of decentralized protocol Sky's USDC liquidity backing its stablecoins.

items.title: Why higher rates could slow Bitcoin buying at treasury firms
items.text: A treasury company can have years of dividends covered and still struggle to sell new shares on terms that make another Bitcoin purchase worthwhile.

items.title: Bitcoin price ignores Anthropic debut as ANT share price dips below $100
items.text: Bitcoin dropped toward a third retest of $62,000 as Anthropic debuted on the Nasdaq, hitting highs of $115 per share before dropping below $100.

items.title: Anthropic gains after IPO, but pulls off highest levels
items.text: After opening at $111.50, ANT quickly slipped back under $100, still above its $83 offering price.

items.title: Rekord an der Börse: Lehren aus dem Anthropic-Börsengang
items.text: Anthropic gelingt der größte Börsengang aller Zeiten. Nach dem Absturz von Nvidia verbindet die KI-Branche damit neue Hoffnungen. Sind die Zweifel am Boom rund um Künstliche Intelligenz nun zerstreut? Von Angela Göpfert.

items.title: Volkswagen will Nullrunden für zwei Jahre
items.text: Nullrunden, weniger Zulagen und Änderungen bei der Arbeitszeit - Volkswagen will harte Einschnitte in der anstehenden Tarifrunde durchsetzen. Die IG Metall wirft dem Konzern vor, mit dem "Messer in den Rücken" der Arbeitnehmer zu fallen.

items.title: BASF bläst Evonik-Übernahme ab
items.text: BASF nimmt Abstand von einer Übernahme des Konkurrenten Evonik. Der Chemiekonzern gibt die Pläne auf, nachdem Evonik zuvor zwei unverbindliche Kaufangebote zurückgewiesen hatte.

items.title: Binance wins $6.5 billion feezing order against hackers behind crypto's largest theft
items.text: The crypto exchange said it has already replaced the stolen assets using its own funds and insurance reserves.

items.title: Firmenporträt: Anthropics halsbrecherischer Aufstieg
items.text: Google schwor einst, nicht böse zu sein. OpenAI wollte KI fürs Gemeinwohl nutzen. Anthropic verspricht Sicherheit. Jetzt kommt der Börsengang - und mit ihm die Frage, die alle Tech-Giganten kennen: Was bleibt vom Ideal, wenn der Markt ruft? Von G. Biesinger.

items.title: Ethereum’s new DeFi security tool raises questions over censorship
items.text: Phylax’s system lets decentralized protocols block potentially harmful transactions, but raises questions about potential censorship and Ethereum’s concentrated builder market.

items.title: Hong Kong adds Hyperliquid to list of ‘suspicious’ crypto platforms
items.text: Hong Kong’s securities regulator said Hyperliquid has no local license and may have promoted its trading services to investors in the city.

items.title: Southeast Asia’s data center boom leaned on Chinese demand. New U.S. rules put that pipeline at risk
items.text: The rules require data centers in Southeast Asia to seek U.S. approval to buy advanced AI chips, threatening to slow a build-out fueled heavily on Chinese demand.

items.title: VW-Chef Blume: "Komplett verändertes Umfeld" zwingt zum Sparkurs
items.text: Bei VW starten kommende Woche die Tarifgespräche. Im NDR-Interview spricht Konzernchef Blume über zu hohe Kosten, teure Werke und den umstrittenen Auftritt des Audi-Chefs in den USA. Von Annette Deutskens.

items.title: Wie riskant ist Nvidias Kurssturz für ETF-Sparer?
items.text: Nach dem Rücktritt von Jensen Huang hat die Nvidia-Aktie massiv an Wert verloren. Weil sie im MSCI World gelistet ist, betrifft das viele ETF-Sparer. Wie schwer der Kursrutsch wiegt - und wo jetzt weitere Gefahren lauern. Von Angela Göpfert.

items.title: Record diesel prices drive UK inflation to 1-year high of 3.6%
items.text: It put the U.K.'s annual inflation rate at a 1-year high.

items.title: Neue Quartalszahlen: Nvidia verdoppelt Umsatz und Gewinn
items.text: Wenige Tage nach der Spionageaffäre rund um den bisherigen Konzernchef Huang hat Nvidia überraschend starke Quartalsergebnisse vorgelegt. Die Zahlen des US-Chipkonzerns lagen deutlich über den Erwartungen von Analysten.

items.title: Japan exports in October surge 20.5%, beating estimates on robust chip shipments
items.text: Semiconductor shipments spiked almost 50% year on year.

items.title: Jensen Huang kann sich Rückkehr an Nvidia-Spitze vorstellen
items.text: Der wegen einer Affäre mit einer mutmaßlichen chinesischen Spionin zurückgetretene Chef des US-Chipkonzerns Nvidia hat gravierende Fehler eingeräumt. Doch sollte der Vorstand das wünschen, würde er gerne an die Unternehmensspitze zurückkehren.
